g.text: Blue favours removing the component; orange favours Full OADE
Component ablation: paired effect relative to Full OADE
Values are matched-pairs rank-biserial effects; * indicates Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.
Two-sided paired Wilcoxon tests, n = 30; correction family contains 30 comparisons per metric.
